output.summary: A bright-green herb native to parts of southern Europe and North Africa, garden parsley grows as a biennial in temperate climates but as an annual in warmer regions. Curly and flat leaves flavour and garnish food, while root parsley is eaten as a vegetable; the seeds are toxic and should be avoided.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves are used as herbs and garnishes, and root parsley is eaten raw or cooked; seeds are toxic and should be avoided.
